description: SereneDB test-config for the vendored duckdb_spatial test suite. The extension is built with no dependency outside this repository: geometry operations run on Boost.Geometry, and GEOS, PROJ and GDAL are not vendored -- see tests/duckdb/README.md.

skip_tests.reason: The persistent RTREE index is not built (SPATIAL_USE_RTREE=OFF). SereneDB indexes geometry through `USING inverted` (iresearch/S2), so spatial's index type, its CREATE INDEX plan, its rtree_index_* pragmas and its scan-pushdown optimizer pass are compiled out rather than merely rejected by the CREATE INDEX access-method whitelist. Every file below creates that index and tests it. The in-memory FlatRTree that accelerates spatial joins is a separate per-query structure, is still built, and its tests (test/sql/join/) run.

GEOS is not vendored (SPATIAL_USE_GEOS=OFF, SPATIAL_USE_BOOST=ON): geometry operations run on Boost.Geometry, which has no equivalent for ST_MakeValid, ST_Node, ST_Polygonize, ST_BuildArea, ST_LineMerge, ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology, ST_ConcaveHull, ST_VoronoiDiagram, ST_MaximumInscribedCircle, ST_MinimumRotatedRectangle, ST_ReducePrecision, ST_AsMVTGeom or the seven ST_Coverage* functions, so none of them is registered, and each file below tests one of them. The rest of test/sql/geos/ uses functions Boost.Geometry does provide and runs.

GDAL and PROJ are not vendored (feat: Boost.Geometry backend, drop PROJ/GDAL/SQLite): ST_Read, ST_Read_Meta, ST_Drivers, COPY ... (FORMAT GDAL) and ST_Transform are not registered. The files under test/sql/gdal/ and test/sql/proj.test test them; test/sql/shapefile/test_shapefile_read.test writes its shapefile through GDAL to compare ST_Read with ST_ReadSHP; test/sql/mvt/st_asmvt.test and test/sql/mvt/st_asmvt_linestring.test read the tiles back through GDAL's MVT driver, and the latter also clips with ST_AsMVTGeom, a GEOS function. test/sql/mvt/st_asmvt_encoding.test pins ST_AsMVT's encoding without GDAL.
